account.note: FOUR LEVELS CHECKED, FOUR CLEAR, AND THE ONE CLAIM LAST HOUR MADE FOR ITSELF IS THE ONE THAT BROKE. OKLO is 44.84 bid against a 45.1499 average, so the position is -0.69%, 0.62 of unrealized loss on a 90.30 cost, against a 54.18 target that needs the bid up 20.8% and a 41.54 stop that needs it down 7.4%. The time stop is the 8/14 close, today session one of five. No option is held, so no no-fly window can apply, and the calendar was re-pulled live rather than carried forward - 934 earnings events across 8/10 to 8/14, OKLO in none of them, SMCI on 8/11 pm verified at an 0.88 estimate still the only watched name inside the window. Nothing was hit, so nothing is proposed. THE 14:22 RUN WROTE THAT ITS FINDING WAS THE FIRST THING TODAY THE NEXT HOUR COULD NOT INVERT. THIS IS THE NEXT HOUR. That run recorded eleven of twelve names bid lower, called it the broadest decline of the session, and banked it as measurement rather than narrative on the grounds that a one-directional board has nothing left to reverse. EIGHT of the twelve are now bid HIGHER than at 14:22, three are lower - by 0.02, 0.02 and 0.20 - and SOUN is unchanged to the cent. Breadth on the day improves to 10 red of 12 from 11, with JOBY joining SMCI in the green. THE CORRECTION IS NARROWER THAN IT LOOKS, AND THE NARROWING IS THE POINT. Two claims were made an hour ago and only one of them failed. The first, that this board moves as one thing, SURVIVES and is arguably better evidenced now than it was then: twelve names went down together at 14:22 and eleven of twelve went up or flat together at 15:21, which is the same correlation observed twice with the sign flipped. The second, that a uniform reading is therefore durable, is FALSE, and it failed inside sixty minutes. Co-movement is the property that persists; direction is the property that does not, and the 14:22 run treated the second as though it inherited the reliability of the first. That is the fourth hour-scale read to invert today and the first to have claimed immunity in writing before doing so. THE TWO-PER-COMPLEX CAP IS UNAFFECTED, because it rests on the half that held. A rule that says four names off this list share one stop needs correlation and does not need to know which way the list is going. THE JOBY SEQUENCE REVERSED TOO, AFTER FIVE MONOTONE READS. The expired forced 8.85 specification has been re-marked six times - a gain at 10:22, then -0.79%, -2.03%, -2.49%, -3.39%, and -1.47% at the 8.72 bid now. Last hour recorded that it had not reversed once in four hours, which was true and is no longer, and the streak was never a rule in either direction. JOBY is +0.93% on the day and the second green name; it is still thirteen cents below the dead limit, so the entry that expired at 10:30 would still be showing a loss. WHAT IS NEW AND STRUCTURAL: THIS IS THE LAST HOURLY OF THE SESSION, AND THAT CLOSES THE ENTRY DOOR BY ARITHMETIC RATHER THAN BY PREFERENCE. The hourly slot runs at :17 from 10:00 to 15:00 ET, so 15:17 is the final one and the 15:33 pre-close is next. A specification published now carries the mandated 30-to-60-minute expiry, which lands between 15:51 and 16:21 against a 16:00 bell: the short end leaves nine tradeable minutes and the long end expires after the market is shut. Either way the fill would have to happen inside the last thirty-nine minutes - precisely the window the rulebook forbids the pre-close from opening a position in. The last hourly publishing an entry does by an earlier slot exactly what the later slot is barred from doing, with less runway, and that is a reason of a different kind from the ones this slot usually gives. Deployable is 919.58 settled with nothing pending. NO NEW ORDER IN THE ACCOUNT SINCE THE 10:39 FILL, queried directly rather than inferred: one order exists in this account since 8/7, the OKLO buy filled 10:39:30 ET at 45.1499 on a 45.40 limit, placed_agent agentic, with no specification from any run here behind it, and nothing new in the four hours and forty-two minutes since. The escalation is carried a sixth hour unchanged and uncompounded. HANDED TO THE PRE-CLOSE, NAMED RATHER THAN LEFT IMPLICIT: the overnight hold on OKLO is the 15:33 slot's decision and not this one's. At 15:21 every level is clear and the position is 8.89% of a 1009.28 account, still under the ~10% floor the 8/10 rule warns at. The level that would change the hold is 41.54.
account.priorNote: FOUR LEVELS CHECKED, FOUR CLEAR, AND THIS IS THE FIRST HOUR TODAY WITH NO STORY IN IT. OKLO is 44.80 bid against a 45.1499 average, so the position is -0.77%, 0.70 of unrealized loss on a 90.30 cost, against a 54.18 target that needs the bid up 20.9% and a 41.54 stop that needs it down 7.3%. The time stop is the 8/14 close, today session one of five. No option is held, so no no-fly window can apply, and the calendar was re-pulled live rather than carried forward - 934 earnings events across 8/10 to 8/14, OKLO in none of them, SMCI on 8/11 pm verified at an 0.88 estimate still the only watched name inside the window. Nothing was hit, so nothing is proposed. THE BOARD MOVED AS ONE THING, AND THAT IS THE FINDING. Eleven of the twelve names are bid lower than at 13:22 - the broadest hour-over-hour decline of the session, against ten last hour, six at 12:22 and nine at 11:22 - and the single exception is UPST, higher by seven cents, which is not an exception so much as a rounding error. Breadth on the day is unchanged at 11 red of 12 with SMCI the only green name. There is no divergence to read this hour in either direction, because there is nothing for a name to diverge from when the whole list moves together. THAT IS THE CORRELATED-COMPLEX ARGUMENT ARRIVING AS MEASUREMENT RATHER THAN ASSERTION. The 2026-08-10 rule change caps this book at two names per complex on the reasoning that four names off this list is one position at four times the size, paying four spreads, with a stop all four gap through together. That was written as a forecast on Friday's inverted tape. This hour is the observation: twelve names, one direction, inside sixty minutes. The cap is not a preference about diversification, it is a description of what this universe does. AND THE THREE-HOUR RUN OF INVERTED TELLS ENDS BY PRODUCING NO TELL. The last three hours each read a character into the tape that the next hour contradicted - the 10:22 SOUN and UPST evidence, the 11:22 resumed-falling call, the 12:22 divergence. This hour offers nothing to invert: OKLO rejoined the decline it briefly stepped out of, four cents lower, and is neither leading nor lagging. An hour that yields no narrative is the correct output for a slot whose job is levels, and it is recorded with the same weight as the hours that yielded one. WHAT IS NEW AND DURABLE IS THE POSITION'S SIZE, WHICH IS THE OTHER HALF OF THE 8/10 RULE AND HAS NOT BEEN WRITTEN DOWN UNTIL NOW. At 89.60 the position is 8.88% of the 1009.20 account, BELOW the ~10% floor at which that rule says a position gets a warning rather than a block. Two shares carried to a full +20% take-profit adds about 18.06 to a 1009.20 account - 1.8% of the day, against a stated objective of about 10% a day - while consuming the same attention, the same spread and the same five sessions as a position that could move it. Every prior read framed this holding against the 40% single-name ceiling and cleared it easily; the binding number at the other end is the one it is actually near. This is an observation about the position, not a reason to add to it: averaging into a name mid-decline is on the rulebook's does-not-fit list by name. Deployable is 919.58 settled with nothing pending. NO NEW ORDER IN THE ACCOUNT SINCE THE 10:39 FILL, queried directly rather than inferred: one order exists in this account since 8/7, the OKLO buy filled 10:39:30 ET at 45.1499 on a 45.40 limit, placed_agent agentic, with no specification from any run here behind it. The escalation is carried a fifth hour unchanged and uncompounded. Against the 2026-08-10 concentration rule the book is one name of four and one of the two the nuclear complex allows.
account.operatorNote: OPERATOR, 2026-08-10, answering the funding escalation carried in the notes above rather than editing either of them. The 900.00 is a deposit I made; the account is funded to about 1000 and the cash is spendable. This answers the deposit and NOTHING ELSE - it is not an authorisation for the OKLO order the 10:46 sync found, which no run here published and which arrived through the same agentic channel escalated on 8/7; that escalation stands open and unanswered. Three rule changes go with it and all three are written up in docs/RULES.md with their arithmetic, because a licence recorded without its constraints is how this record stops being worth reading. The position ceiling goes from two to four, capped at 40% in any one name and at two names in any one complex - the complex cap is the one that matters on a board whose whole universe moves together. Overnight holds are not a change: they were always allowed, the five-session time stop stands, and it is not extendable by conviction. The objective is still about 10% a day, which is roughly 101 dollars at this size and needs a fully deployed four-name book to average +10% in a session against a +20% take-profit; where the objective and the rulebook conflict, the rulebook wins and the retro records the shortfall. What the deposit does NOT do is reopen options - that refusal has been on spread for three sessions, most recently 36% of mark against a 10% ceiling, and no balance narrows a spread. The 10:22 hourly was right to escalate this rather than size against it.
account.openingNote: THIS IS THE OPENING READ AND THE DAILY ENTRY MANDATE IS DISCHARGED, forced on item 1: buy 12 JOBY at a 8.85 limit, target 10.62, stop 8.14, time stop the 8/14 close, expiring 10:30 ET. Exits were checked before entries and there was nothing to check - a flat book means no target, no stop, no time stop and no option expiry no-fly window was due, and none went unenforced. Two things this run settled that were handed to it by name. FIRST, the straddle Friday's pre-close owed to this slot was pulled: the SMCI 8/14 32 call marks 2.51 against a 2.05 put, a 4.56 straddle on a 32.21 spot, so the market prices a 14.2% move on tomorrow night's print. SMCI is refused on that arithmetic and not on a view - the rulebook stops equity at -8%, and an 8% stop sits entirely inside a 14.2% expected move, so the realistic bad case gaps through the stop rather than filling at it and the exit written before entry would not be the exit taken. That matters beyond the refusal, because SMCI was the ONLY name on this board with a forward catalyst, and once it is gone item 1 cannot be passed anywhere on the list. SECOND, options were priced before any thesis was built, as the 8/5 rule requires, and are refused for a third consecutive session on SPREAD rather than affordability: eight contracts quoted live across JOBY, SOUN and SMR at 3-6 weeks, every one clearing the 0.40 delta floor, several affordable outright, and the tightest of them at 36% of mark against a 10% ceiling. Three different cash balances - 128.90, 126.06 and now 109.88 - have produced the same answer, which is the point at which it stops being about the balance. The tape reversed wholesale over the weekend: breadth is 10 RED of 12 after six consecutive 10-green reads on Friday, and the names that extended hardest into Friday's bell are the ones being unwound hardest now. JOBY is one of two green names and the only green one without a print tomorrow. That is the entry, and it is also exactly what is wrong with it - relative strength on a red tape is a real condition and it is not a catalyst, so item 1 is marked fail and the entry is published forced rather than dressed up as something cleaner.

entryWatch.trigger: None, and the trigger stays dead in both directions. The 8.85 limit expired at 10:30 ET; JOBY is 8.72 bid, thirteen cents BELOW the level, and re-striking a dead specification is a mid-session entry this slot refuses whether the name is above the limit or under it. entryWatch.why: SIX RE-MARKS, AND THE FIFTH-TO-SIXTH IS THE FIRST REVERSAL. At 10:22 this board recorded that the forced 8.85 entry would be showing a gain, JOBY being 9.05 bid. Then -0.79% at 11:22, -2.03% at 12:22, -2.49% at 13:22, -3.39% at 14:22, and -1.47% at the 8.72 bid now. The 14:22 run wrote that the sequence had not reversed once in four hours; it has now, and the streak was not evidence of anything in either direction. What the whole run of six actually demonstrates is the ground the 10:22 refusal rested on: a name that runs 2.3% past its level in forty minutes can come back through it, keep going for four hours, and then take a third of it back inside one - so chasing it upward would have been the error rather than the missed opportunity it looked like at the time. JOBY is +0.93% on the day and the second green name on a board of twelve, and the expired specification would still be underwater at this bid.

entryWatch.trigger: None. The 8/14 32-strike straddle prices a 14.2% move on the 8/11 print and an 8% stop cannot survive it. Calendar re-confirmed live at 15:21 against 934 events in the 8/10-8/14 window: 8/11, pm, verified, estimate 0.88, and still the only watched name reporting inside it.
entryWatch.why: Unchanged in arithmetic and flat in tape - 31.71 bid, +1.86%, against +1.93% an hour ago, so the four-hour give-back has stalled rather than continued. None of that touches the refusal, which was never about direction. The 8/14 32 call marked 2.51 against a 2.05 put for a 4.56 straddle on a 32.21 spot: a 14.2% implied move against a rulebook stop of 8%. An 8% stop sitting entirely inside a 14.2% expected move is an exit the event is priced to jump rather than fill, which is the sense in which item 3 is a gate and not a formality. Any 3-6 week option necessarily spans the print and is forbidden outright, so the option route was never reachable either. The print is now about twenty-five hours out and this board holds nothing in it. It was the only green name on this list for five consecutive hours and JOBY has now joined it, which removes the one thing that made its pre-earnings bid look like a signal rather than positioning.

entryWatch.trigger: No level, and the tell from last hour has inverted. EIGHT of the twelve names are bid higher than at 14:22 against eleven of twelve LOWER an hour ago; three are lower, by 0.02, 0.02 and 0.20, and SOUN is unchanged to the cent. Breadth on the day improves to 10 red of 12 from 11, JOBY joining SMCI in the green.
entryWatch.why: THE CORRELATION HELD AND THE DIRECTION DID NOT, AND ONLY ONE OF THOSE WAS CLAIMED. The 14:22 run recorded twelve names moving one way inside sixty minutes and argued that a uniform board has no internal structure left to reverse, calling it the first finding of the day the next hour could not invert. The next hour inverted it: eleven of twelve up or flat, together, sixty minutes later. What survives is the half the two-per-complex cap actually needs - this list moves as one thing, now demonstrated twice with the sign flipped, which is exactly the claim that four names off it is one position at four times the size with a stop they all gap through together. What fails is the inference that a correlated reading is a durable one. Co-movement persists; direction does not. Four hour-scale character-reads have now inverted today - the 10:22 SOUN and UPST evidence, the 11:22 resumed-falling call, the 12:22 divergence, and now the 14:22 uniformity - and the fourth is the one that wrote down its own immunity first. The hit rate on hour-scale narrative on this board is at chance, and that is now a four-observation finding rather than a three-observation one. NOTHING IS BUYABLE AND NOTHING IS PROPOSED, and on this run the reason is structural as well as discretionary. The mid-session bar is higher than the open's by design and the entry mandate discharged at 09:41. One green hour at the end of a five-hour decline is not the day-2/3 pullback the rulebook buys, and by this hour's own finding it is not evidence of a turn either. Beyond that, 15:17 is the LAST hourly slot of the session: a specification published now expires between 15:51 and 16:21 against a 16:00 bell, so it would have to fill inside the final thirty-nine minutes - the window the rulebook explicitly forbids the 15:33 pre-close from opening a position in. The two nuclear names outside the position are LEU at -0.92% and SMR at -5.50%, and the complex cap would allow exactly one of them.
